title: NextStepsStoredResponse
description: CLOSED data object of the stored-guidance read (viewer GET of next steps). The read returns already stored guidance only: it never generates guidance, persists a decision or variant assignment, schedules a job or invokes a provider (generation is a separate write). Two separately addressable states: NotGeneratedResponse (no stored guidance; the exact empty body) and ReadyResponse (the bounded stored projection: decision id, public category, evidence hash, evidence level and action kind only). The stored rationale, command template, internal operation vocabulary and customer content are never returned.

NotGeneratedResponse.description: Authorized run with no stored guidance: exactly this empty body inside the normal response envelope.

state.description: Guidance has not been generated for this run.

variant_assignment.description: Always null: the read never pins a variant.

ReadyResponse.description: Stored guidance exists: the bounded stored projection. Rationale and command template are deliberately absent.

next_steps.description: Always empty on the stored read: the single decision is authoritative (as in the lifecycle response, a decision excludes next_steps).

variant_assignment.description: Always null: the read never pins a variant.

StoredDecision.description: Closed projection of the newest stored decision for the run.

evidence_snapshot_hash.description: Opaque content hash joining the decision to its redacted evidence snapshot.

evidence_level.description: Coarse evidence level. Values matching the pattern are returned as stored; values that do not match are returned as null.

action_kind.description: Action surface kind. Values matching the pattern are returned as stored; values that do not match are returned as null.
